subject: ArmVirtPkg: Add a helper to check protected MMIO address
reasons: This commit adds a new function ArmCcaMemRangeIsProtectedMmio() to both the real ArmCcaLib and the null stub. It is new functionality being added, not a transformation of existing code.
Adding a new function symmetrically to a library and its null stub is a code-authoring pattern, not a match-and-replace transformation expressible in SmPL.
There are no existing call sites or structural patterns being changed across the codebase; the commit is purely additive.
